verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mangopay supports payouts from wallets to users' external bank accounts, with smart routing to domestic rails for cost and speed. It also mentions automated payouts for Mirakl marketplaces, which implies platform-triggered or automated payouts. Nothing documents configurable per-seller payout schedules or instant payouts. Missing for 10: daily/weekly/monthly payout scheduling, per-seller schedule configuration, instant payouts to cards or real-time rails, independent or hands-on corroboration.
